description: This file manages dependencies for the Playwright project, including functions for installing, validating, and handling dependencies across different platforms (Windows, Linux). It includes methods for reading/writing Docker info, checking executables, and handling shared libraries. It also defines utility functions for process elevation and dependency checks.

methods.name: writeDockerVersion
methods.description: Writes Docker version info to a file and sets permissions.

methods.name: dockerVersion
methods.description: Generates Docker image name with current version.

methods.name: readDockerVersionSync
methods.description: Reads Docker version info from file synchronously.

methods.name: installDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Installs Windows dependencies like media packs if needed.

methods.name: installDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Installs Linux dependencies for specified target groups.

methods.name: validateDependenciesWindows
methods.description: Checks for missing Windows dependencies and provides guidance.

methods.name: validateDependenciesLinux
methods.description: Checks for missing Linux dependencies and provides guidance.
